name: Galleonaire
description:
How well do you know the wizarding world? Galleonaire brings 1,500 independently written Harry Potter knowledge questions to iPhone and Apple Watch.

CLIMB THE CLASSIC LADDER
Answer fifteen increasingly challenging questions on your way to a fictional million-galleon prize. Use lifelines when you need a helping hand, and discover explanations as you play.

TAKE YOUR WIZARDING EXAMS
Choose one of ten subjects covering characters and families; spells and defence; potions, plants and healing; transformations; magical creatures; wizarding education; history and society; objects, wands and places; Quidditch and challenges; and the Harry Potter films.

O.W.L. papers contain 20 intermediate questions and are untimed. N.E.W.T. papers contain 50 expert questions, with a choice of 25 minutes, 37 minutes 30 seconds, or no time limit. Both qualifications cover the full series, so expect spoilers.

Answer, skip, revisit and change your responses. Progress is saved as you go. After submission, see your exact score, full grade, pass or fail result and explanations. Retakes draw a fresh random selection and shuffle the order; saved attempts keep their original paper. Timed exams continue while the app is closed or your Watch sleeps.

FOLLOW YOUR PROGRESS
Clear Statistics sections show your Classic record, topic performance and exam achievements. Explore individual attempts and see your best results by subject and qualification.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Native controls, VoiceOver support, adjustable text and independent music, sound-effect and haptic settings help you enjoy the game your way. Both apps work independently offline. Records and saved exams stay on the device where you played them.

No advertising, analytics, accounts or tracking. Galleons are fictional points with no monetary value. An independent fan-made quiz, not affiliated with or endorsed by the authors, publishers or film studios referenced.

• N.E.W.T. — 50 expert questions. Choose 25 minutes, an extended 37 minutes 30 seconds, or an untimed paper.

Skip, revisit and change answers before submitting. Save an exam and return later, then discover your score, full grade and answer explanations. Each new attempt shuffles the selection and answer order for fresh variety. Timed papers continue while the app is closed or your Watch sleeps.

CLEARER STATISTICS
Explore a redesigned Statistics screen with clearer summaries and easier navigation. See your Classic record, performance across ten topics, and exam results in separate sections.

Enjoy Classic and Exam Mode on iPhone and Apple Watch, including offline play.
reviewNotes:
Public update to the existing Galleonaire app. No login, purchases, ads or backend. All content works offline. The signed iPhone app embeds the companion Apple Watch app, which also works independently.

The public version adds Exam Mode and redesigned Statistics to the previously released Classic game. The shared database now contains 1,500 questions (the original 1,000 plus 500 additions); exam pools are subsets of that total. There are 196 additions since build 49. Galleons are fictional points, not currency or gambling stakes.

Open Exam Mode, choose O.W.L. or N.E.W.T., choose any of ten subjects, and activate Begin Exam. O.W.L. has 20 untimed questions. N.E.W.T. has 50 questions with standard 25-minute, extended 37-minute-30-second or untimed options. Answers can be skipped, changed and reviewed before submission. Submit Exam can complete a paper early; unanswered questions score zero. Full grades and explanations appear afterwards. Use Resume Exam to continue saved work. A timed exam's deadline continues while the app is closed.

Statistics separates Classic records, topic performance and completed exam results. Existing records and saved papers are retained. This is an independent fan quiz using original question wording, original app artwork and original nonverbal audio. No film audio or recorded narration is included.
